files.name: dochi_cobblemon_editor-0.2.7-fabric-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.2.7 Change Log

  • Battle AI: Improved decision-making for screens, Trick Room, stat-boosting moves, switching, battle gimmicks, and team synergy.
  • Move Selection: Added support for selecting all registered moves, with regular, event-exclusive, and legacy moves prioritized in the list.
  • Added compatibility with Cobblemon 1.8.3 / 1.8.4.
  • Added the ability to open dialogues through After Actions.
